outcome: Genital tract tears (overall and specific types)
cohort: 10,629 women with live, singleton, non-instrumental births in cephalic presentation
finding: Women who gave birth on a birth seat had a lower chance of an overall intact genital tract compared to other positions, despite a lower episiotomy rate.
mod_finding: Women who gave birth vaginally on a birth seat after a previous cesarean section may have an increased risk of sustaining a sphincter tear.
